task.title: Broken gate on empty payload
task.description:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Start the runner with an empty payload
2. Send SIGTERM during startup

Observed: the gate crashes with a nil map read. Expected: the gate rejects the payload with a typed error.

comments.comment: Reproduced on build 2024.1: runner log shows `panic: assignment to entry in nil map` right after the payload handshake.
Second occurrence after the 2024.2 upgrade; same signature. Attaching run id rr-4821.
